answer: Resist sybils with threshold-issued identities: no identity key exists until a threshold of independent trustees co-signs its creation, like a canyon pass that opens only when several keepers turn their keys together. Each trustee holds one shale-thin fragment of the signing key, useless alone. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must corrupt a threshold of trustees per fake, and each corruption ripples through public audit logs, exposing the conspiracy, while an honest agent is issued once and keeps its standing.
